verdict.rationale: Kong ships an official Konnect MCP Server (kong-docs-66, kong-probe-3), which lets AI-native users operate Kong Konnect via natural-language commands through an MCP client, and Kong also documents AI Gateway support for AI CLIs/agent traffic (kong-docs-58). However, this NL control is scoped to Konnect cloud management rather than the core Gateway, documentation is thin (a one-line stub), and there's no independent/hands-on evidence of the breadth or reliability of natural-language operation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on supported commands/scope, independent user validation, and NL support for the open-source Gateway itself (not just Konnect).
